proof_candidate_stress_failure_modes.description: Failure modes detected or injected during adversarial stress testing of proof candidates.

failure_modes.name: adversarial_counterexample_leakage
failure_modes.description: An adversarial counterexample is found that bypasses existing boundary and failure-mode checks.

failure_modes.name: boundary_case_escape
failure_modes.description: Stress at the exact window boundary results in undefined or inadmissible process state.

failure_modes.name: dependency_fragility
failure_modes.description: Removal or weakening of a registered dependency collapses the proof's symbolic validity.

failure_modes.name: quantifier_scope_explosion
failure_modes.description: Adversarial input demonstrates that a universal quantifier holds only for a restricted or empty subset.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_breakdown
failure_modes.description: Adversarial conditions break a declared equivalence relation between primitives.

failure_modes.name: recursive_instability_resonance
failure_modes.description: Injected perturbations amplify across recursive iterations, leading to transport closure loss.

failure_modes.name: degenerate_minima_chaos
failure_modes.description: Adversarial degenerate cases result in non-unique and unstable continuation selection.

failure_modes.name: nonlocal_transport_leakage
failure_modes.description: Stress testing of CSI radii shows contribution leakage beyond the declared interaction domain.

failure_modes.name: implicit_global_claim_leakage
failure_modes.description: A local derivation is found to depend on an unstated global assumption, violating humility.
